title: Echo Chamber | ECHO//100 Episode 23
description: Kavi discovers a derelict phone booth broadcasting warnings from a discarded timeline. He must silence his own future to prevent the city's collapse. Episode 23 of ECHO//100: The City Without Shadows. This content features AI-assisted original fiction.

scenes.text: Kavi halts as his own voice broadcasts from a rusted, sparking phone booth nearby.
scenes.caption: Voice from the booth
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi in his red hoodie and glasses standing before an old phone booth in a dark alley.

scenes.text: The recording warns Kavi against trusting the entity currently hiding inside his own mind.
scenes.caption: A chilling warning
scenes.image_prompt: Close up of Kavi's face, his eyes wide, reflection of a phone booth in his glasses.

scenes.text: Metallic booth walls suddenly fold inward like paper, collapsing into a flat, two-dimensional plane.
scenes.caption: Geometry collapsing
scenes.image_prompt: The phone booth warping into a two-dimensional shape against the brick wall of the alley.

scenes.text: Kavi reaches toward the portal, recognizing a direct connection to the terrifying Discarded Timeline.
scenes.caption: Portal to nowhere
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi reaching toward the flat, glowing rift where the phone booth used to stand.

scenes.text: Blue light floods the alley while erased silhouettes scream silently from the void beyond.
scenes.caption: The erased ones
scenes.image_prompt: Ghostly silhouettes pressing against the flat plane of light, reaching for Kavi.

scenes.text: To save the city, Kavi deletes the connection, permanently silencing the warning from his future.
scenes.caption: The heavy choice
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi hovering his hand over a glowing 'delete' icon shimmering in the air.

scenes.text: He executes the command, causing the booth to shatter into digital dust and vanish.
scenes.caption: Deleting the truth
scenes.image_prompt: The folding phone booth exploding into sparkling digital pixels, fading into the night.

scenes.text: The voice echoes one final time, claiming it is not Kavi but rather Null.
scenes.caption: The true identity
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi looking down, his shadow shifting into the black-purple glitch form of Null.
